condition: The cardboard box is open, clean, and structurally intact with minor creases on the flaps.

safety.handling_warning: Handle normally as it is clean paper material.

concepts.title: Reinforce Flaps
concepts.description: Strengthen worn cardboard flaps with extra tape to restore the box for shipping or storage.
steps: Inspect the open box for any weak creases along the corrugated cardboard flaps.
Cut a strip of packaging tape slightly longer than the weakened flap edge.
Press the tape firmly along the outer seam of the bottom flaps.
Repeat the taping process for the top opening flaps to secure structural integrity.
Test the box by gently pressing the bottom to ensure it holds weight.
concepts.image_prompt: A reinforced brown corrugated cardboard box with clean tape along the seams, set on a plain neutral background in soft natural light.

concepts.title: Drawer Organiser
concepts.description: Cut down the height of the corrugated cardboard box to create custom storage bins for wardrobe drawers.
steps: Place the corrugated cardboard box on a flat surface.
Measure and mark a horizontal cutting line around the sides at your desired drawer depth.
Use the utility knife and metal ruler to carefully slice along the marked lines.
Remove the top section of the box, leaving a clean shallow tray.
Smooth any rough cardboard edges by pressing down with the back of the knife blade.
concepts.image_prompt: A shallow brown corrugated cardboard storage tray neatly placed on a plain background, lit with soft natural light.

concepts.title: Woven Storage Basket
concepts.description: Transform the corrugated cardboard into paper yarn and weave a stylish small storage basket.
steps: Disassemble the corrugated cardboard box completely so it lies flat.
Cut the flat cardboard sheets into long, uniform strips using scissors and a ruler.
Fold each cardboard strip lengthwise to create sturdy paper yarn strands.
Create a base square by intersecting several rigid cardboard strips.
Weave the remaining paper yarn strands in an over-under pattern around upright uprights.
Secure the final woven ends with craft glue and let dry completely.
concepts.image_prompt: A small woven storage basket made from brown corrugated cardboard strips, standing on a neutral surface with soft natural lighting.
